notices.title: A new version of Lunchbox is available
notices.body: You're on 0.1.1, which can't update itself on a Mac. Paste one line in Terminal and Lunchbox updates and reopens with everything as it was. After that, updates take one click.

notices.title: Lunchbox 0.1.6 is here
notices.body: See what every agent is doing while it works, with a plan that ticks off as it goes. Local and API models can now work in your folder, you can ask an agent by name, and Expert mode designs more like a senior designer. It downloads by itself: click Restart now at the top of the window, or quit and reopen Lunchbox.
